definitional_roots_policy: Read from reorder/policy.json; do not treat scope floor entries as definitional roots.

virtual_structures.title: Classical propositional L-structure
virtual_structures.description: A propositional analogue of an L-structure: a classical interpretation for a propositional language, assigning truth values to atoms and extending recursively over formulas according to the connectives.
dependency_policy: This virtual structure is context for semantic decomposition, not a real graph node.
Do not emit floor:propositional-l-structure as a dependency.
Emit concrete component concepts only when they are needed to state the reviewed node and are not inherited through a nearer accepted dependency.
Use satisfaction/truth-assignment concepts for semantic nodes rather than repeatedly emitting every syntax ingredient.

inference_policy: First decompose the statement into ambient environment, structures, instances, operations, predicates, conditions, and assertions.
Then derive statement dependency concepts from the decomposition.
For theorems, lemmas, propositions, and corollaries, separately infer proof dependency concepts likely needed for proof but not for statement parsing.
Mark proof dependencies inferred without proof text as low or medium confidence unless the statement directly names the fact.
Do not emit dependencies for accepted definitional roots unless the reviewed statement is explicitly about that root.
Prefer nearest mathematical ancestors for shared ambient structure.
